import hashlib,json,ast,tokenize,io
from pathlib import Path
p=Path("research/irc-baseline-config-v3.json")
c=json.loads(p.read_text())
old=json.loads(Path("research/irc-baseline-config-v2.json").read_text())
for key in ("recipe","candidates","zero_shares","packet","packet_sha256","selection","sampling","generation_batch","generation_steps","target_examples_sha256","eos_token_ids"):
    assert c[key]==old[key],key
assert all(hashlib.sha256(Path(n).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for n,h in c["source_sha256"].items())
assert hashlib.sha256(Path(c["preregistration"]["protocol"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==c["preregistration"]["sha256"]
for name in ("scripts/run_irc_baseline.py","tests/test_irc_baseline_failures.py"):
    source=Path(name).read_text()
    ast.parse(source)
    assert len(source.splitlines())<=300
    assert not any(t.type==tokenize.COMMENT for t in tokenize.generate_tokens(io.StringIO(source).readline))
print(json.dumps({"status":"pass","config_sha256":hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"source_count":len(c["source_sha256"]),"unchanged_scientific_fields":12,"code_no_comments_syntax":True,"config_lines":len(p.read_text().splitlines())}))
